title: The NYC Lease Renewal Hike
prompt: Your Brooklyn landlord sends your lease renewal with a $200/month increase (from $1,850 to $2,050). You have 30 days to respond.

options.label: Absorb the increase and renew
options.description: Stay in your familiar apartment. Avoid moving friction and moving costs.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Reduces monthly savings capacity by 10% unless discretionary dining/shopping is trimmed.

options.label: Negotiate for a 2-year lease at +$75/month
options.description: Counter-offer a modest $75/month increase in exchange for signing a guaranteed 24-month lease.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Saves $1,500/year compared to landlord's initial ask and locks in housing predictability.

options.label: Move to Queens with a roommate ($1,400/mo share)
options.description: Incur one-time moving costs ($1,100 for U-Haul, movers, security deposit shift), but drop rent to $1,400.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Upfront hit to emergency fund, but frees up $5,400/year to accelerate retirement and emergency savings.

title: Career Fork: Series B Startup vs. Corporate Firm
prompt: You receive two job offers. A fast-growing fintech startup offers $82k base + stock options with high deductible health plans. A stable enterprise offers $74k base + 6% 401(k) match and comprehensive medical/HSA benefits.

options.label: Take the Series B Startup ($82k base + options)
options.description: Maximize immediate cash salary and potential equity upside. Less generous health/retirement match.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Higher gross cash flow, but requires self-disciplined retirement investing without an employer match.

options.label: Take the Enterprise ($74k base + 6% 401(k) match + HSA seed)
options.description: Guaranteed $4,440/yr employer match, lower health insurance premiums, and $1,000 employer HSA contribution.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Total compensation equals startup once match ($4,440) and HSA ($1,000) are factored in, with higher stability.

title: Emergency Room Sprained Ankle & CT Scan
prompt: A bad slip while running leads to an emergency room visit, X-rays, and an ankle boot. You receive an explanation of benefits: your bill is $1,850 before your HDHP deductible is reached.

options.label: Pay in full from emergency savings
options.description: Wipe out $1,850 of your cash cushion immediately to avoid dealing with billing administrators.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Drains emergency savings runway by ~1 month, leaving you vulnerable to secondary shocks.

options.label: Request itemized bill and 0% 12-month payment plan
options.description: Request itemized billing to drop erroneous charges, then establish a 0% interest payment plan ($135/mo for 12 mos).

financial_effects.stability_impact: Keeps cash buffer liquid; itemization typically shaves $200-$300 off hospital facility fees.

options.label: Pay using accumulated triple-tax-advantaged HSA funds
options.description: Use pre-tax dollars saved in your HSA. Reimburses the bill with 100% tax-free dollars.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Saves ~$550 in effective federal/state/FICA taxes compared to paying out of post-tax checking.

title: Freelance Work Laptop Dies
prompt: Your primary laptop for side-gig design contracts suffers liquid damage. You need a replacement to fulfill $1,200/month of ongoing freelance design work.

options.label: Buy top-tier new M3 Pro MacBook on 24.99% Store Card ($2,400)
options.description: Financed on a retail credit card with minimum payments.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Dangerous high-interest debt trap; accrues over $500 in interest over 18 months.

options.label: Buy certified refurbished MacBook ($1,150) in cash
options.description: Purchase Apple Certified Refurbished with 1-year warranty using emergency cash reserve.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Temporary cash dip quickly recouped by ongoing $1,200/mo freelance revenue with zero debt interest.

title: Best Friend's Destination Wedding in Italy
prompt: Your college roommate invites you to their wedding on Lake Como. Flights, lodging, attire, and gifts will run approximately $2,200.

options.label: Attend full week vacation ($2,200 charged to credit card)
options.description: Carried over 6 months at 21% APR.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Significant social reward, but costs an extra $250 in interest and drains cash flow.

options.label: Attend weekend only, book flight points + budget hostel ($1,050 cash)
options.description: Use travel credit card points, stay in a shared Airbnb with mutual friends, pay cash.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Maintains social connection while halving total out-of-pocket spend; zero debt burden.

options.label: Politely decline in-person, send thoughtful $150 gift
options.description: Prioritize financial foundation and emergency fund buildout.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Preserves over $2,000 for emergency savings, but with some social FOMO.

title: Company 401(k) Auto-Enrollment Window
prompt: Your employer auto-enrolls you at 3% contribution. Their policy offers a 100% match up to 5% of salary ($3,400/yr free match on your $68k salary).

options.label: Leave at default 3% ($170/mo from paycheck)
options.description: Captures $2,040 of match, leaving $1,360/year of employer match unclaimed.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Positive retirement start, but sacrifices $1,360/year of guaranteed 100% employer return.

options.label: Increase to 5% to capture 100% of employer match ($283/mo)
options.description: Take full advantage of the 5% match. Paycheck drops by ~$205/mo after federal/state tax savings.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Maximizes guaranteed 100% immediate return on match; builds $6,800/yr in tax-advantaged wealth.

options.label: Opt out completely to maximize take-home pay
options.description: Receive extra $125/mo in paycheck, but forfeit $3,400/yr of free money.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Severe long-term opportunity loss; forfeit hundreds of thousands in 30-year compound growth.

title: Surprise $2,800 Tax Refund & Bonus
prompt: You file your taxes and receive a combined federal and NY state tax refund plus a performance spot bonus totaling $2,800.

options.label: Deposit 100% into High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA)
options.description: Boost emergency fund from $3,200 to $6,000, achieving a full 3 months of basic NYC expenses.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Major leap in financial stability; unlocks true baseline peace of mind.

options.label: Split: $1,400 to HYSA emergency fund, $1,400 to Roth IRA index fund
options.description: Strengthen cash buffer while seeding long-term tax-free compound growth.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Balanced approach advancing both short-term security and multi-decade wealth.

options.label: Upgrade wardrobe & take weekend trip to Montauk ($2,800)
options.description: Spend windfall entirely on lifestyle upgrades.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Zero financial resilience gained; emergency fund remains dangerously lean.

title: Credit Card Balance & 0% Balance Transfer Offer
prompt: You have a lingering $3,500 credit card balance carrying 24.99% APR, costing you ~$73/month in pure interest. You receive an offer for a 0% APR balance transfer for 15 months (3% transfer fee).

options.label: Accept 0% balance transfer and pay $240/month
options.description: Pay $105 one-time transfer fee, then pay $240/mo to be completely debt-free in 15 months.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Saves ~$980 in predatory interest charges; boosts credit score as utilization drops to zero.

options.label: Continue paying minimum payment (~$90/month) at 24.99%
options.description: Make minimal dent in principal while paying majority to interest.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Takes over 5 years to clear, costing more than $2,100 in cumulative interest.

title: Freelance Brand Consulting Opportunity
prompt: A boutique marketing agency in Manhattan offers you an ongoing monthly retainer for 12 hours of weekend design work at $75/hour ($900/month gross).

options.label: Accept retainer and allocate 30% to quarterly estimated taxes
options.description: Earn $900/mo gross, save $270 for taxes, netting $630/mo pure additional cash flow.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Expands monthly savings rate by over 15%, greatly accelerating emergency fund and IRA targets.

options.label: Decline to protect weekend work-life balance and mental health
options.description: Focus 100% on primary career advancement and skill-building.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Preserves personal time and prevents burnout, but cash flow remains tightly bound to day job.

title: Benefits Open Enrollment: PPO vs. HDHP + HSA
prompt: It's November open enrollment. You are healthy and visit the doctor 1-2 times a year. Plan A: PPO ($180/mo premium, $500 deductible). Plan B: HDHP ($75/mo premium, $1,650 deductible, employer contributes $600 to your HSA).

options.label: Choose HDHP + HSA and contribute $150/month pre-tax
options.description: Save $105/mo in payroll premiums, gain $600 free employer seed, and save ~$55/mo in taxes on HSA contributions.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Leverages the triple-tax advantage (pre-tax, tax-free growth, tax-free withdrawal for medical); builds healthcare nest egg.

options.label: Stick with traditional PPO for perceived peace of mind
options.description: Pay $180/mo payroll deduction ($2,160/year) with no HSA vehicle.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Guarantees lower co-pays, but wastes ~$1,800/yr in higher premiums and forfeited employer HSA seed.

title: Stock Market Pullback: S&P 500 Dips 18%
prompt: Inflation concerns and interest rate volatility trigger a headline-dominating 18% market correction over 3 weeks. Your 401(k) and IRA show red balances.

options.label: Panic sell index fund holdings to cash to 'stop the bleeding'
options.description: Convert paper losses into permanent realized losses.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Locks in losses at market bottom; misses subsequent historical recoveries.

options.label: Stay the course and maintain automatic monthly dollar-cost averaging
options.description: Do not alter your automated contributions. Buy index shares at an 18% discount.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Classic evidence-based index investing practice; historically yields strong long-term upside.

options.label: Trim $100 from monthly dining out to buy extra index fund shares
options.description: Opportunistically buy low during market distress.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Boosts long-term wealth accumulation by acquiring undervalued equities with zero leverage.

title: Unexpected Dental Crown
prompt: A fractured molar requires a porcelain crown. Basic dental insurance covers 50%, leaving you with an out-of-pocket patient balance of $850.

options.label: Pay with HSA debit card
options.description: Use pre-tax HSA funds accumulated earlier.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Zero impact on checking account or credit score; saves ~30% in effective income tax.

options.label: Ask dental office for 5% cash discount, pay from checking
options.description: Most private dentists give 5-10% discount for cash/debit settlement in full ($780).

financial_effects.stability_impact: Mild hit to emergency fund, but captures instant $70 discount.

title: Trial Guard Subscription Audit
prompt: Futurewise flags 4 lingering subscriptions and forgotten auto-renewals (streaming services, premium apps, news tiers) totaling $78/month.

options.label: Audit and cancel unused subscriptions immediately
options.description: Cancel 3 unused subscriptions, retaining only 1 core favorite. Saves $62/month.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Recovers $744/year with zero change in quality of life; automatically redirected to savings.

options.label: Postpone decision ('I might watch that show next month')
options.description: Keep all subscriptions active.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Quiet cash drain that bleeds over $700 annually on unused digital services.

title: Roommate Announces Sudden Relocation
prompt: Your roommate gives 30 days notice that they are moving to Los Angeles. You either need to find a vetted replacement or cover their $1,200 share until the lease expires in 3 months.

options.label: Vigorously interview and screen a replacement roommate
options.description: List room on trusted housing boards. Find replacement with clean credit and background check within 3 weeks.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Minor screening and posting expense avoids a disastrous $3,600 rent shortfall.

options.label: Cover the whole rent alone for 3 months ($3,600 total)
options.description: Enjoy living alone for 90 days before lease ends.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Severely exhausts emergency fund; consumes nearly 50% of monthly net income.

title: Year-End Roth IRA Contribution Sprint
prompt: It's December 15. You have contributed $4,500 of the $7,000 annual limit to your Roth IRA. You have $2,500 in excess checking beyond your 3-month emergency fund.

options.label: Max out the full $7,000 limit with the remaining $2,500
options.description: Fill your annual tax-free bucket completely before the April tax deadline.

financial_effects.stability_impact: Compounds tax-free for the next 35 years; projected to grow to over $26,000 at historical 7% real returns.

options.label: Keep the $2,500 in cash HYSA buffer
options.description: Forego maxing out the tax-free vehicle to maintain an extra thick cash blanket.

financial_effects.stability_impact: High nominal safety, but permanently forfeits this year's irreplaceable $2,500 tax-free capacity.
